note: The only text that may be folded under a "Learn more" row: plain how-to, word for word. Privacy, consent, and urgent-help wording never goes here. Add a line only after a founder agrees it is purely how-to.
en: Add a place by choosing it on a map, or by searching an address. Give it a name only you need to understand, and choose how close counts.
To share something, tap Share on a check-in, a journal entry, or something you kept, then choose "Send to my circle".
es: Agrega un lugar eligiéndolo en un mapa, o buscando una dirección. Ponle un nombre que solo tú necesites entender, y elige qué tan cerca cuenta.
Para compartir algo, toca Compartir en un registro, una entrada del diario o algo que guardaste, y luego elige "Enviar a mi círculo".
